items.text: Markets: Monday's Huang sugar rush is wearing off. Before the bell, Nasdaq-100 futures are down about 2%, S&P 500 futures down 1.2%, and Dow futures down 0.6%. Nvidia is giving back about 5% after a 31% Monday.
Markets: Bitcoin is back down hugging $60,000 after briefly topping $64K Monday. Spot bitcoin ETFs just set a record too, the wrong kind: $4.71 billion pulled out in November.
Took a Hit: Anthropic slipped below its $83 IPO price in premarket trading, about a week after its blockbuster debut. Round trip complete.
Still Broken: Jensen Huang got his Nvidia job back, but the China chip mess didn't reset with him. Sen. Tom Cotton: "Congress has much to investigate."
What's New: Tariffs are making a comeback. The U.S. is reportedly getting ready to raise tariffs on China, the EU and other countries, with China likely hit hardest.
Leveling Up: Rudy Giuliani is set to get the Presidential Medal of Freedom from Trump today. He says he's "humbled and honored."
Took a Hit: Trump's meme coin went from over $70 to under a dollar, which made the top-holder dinner a whole lot cheaper to get into. Gift box included a little golden Trump statue.
Happening Now: Today is the busiest flying day of Thanksgiving week. 52,000+ flights, and the FAA says the busiest holiday skies in 16 years. Pack patience.
Took a Hit: Thanksgiving travel spawns a storm on both coasts. Rain and mountain snow out West, then a nor'easter with heavy rain and strong winds rolling up the East on Turkey Day itself.
Happening Now: The 100th Macy's parade has 100 balloons and one rule: no flying if gusts top 34 mph. Thursday's storm is about to test it.
Leveling Up: Jayden Daniels does the clutch thing AGAIN. Two passes, 64 yards, walk-off field goal, Commanders over Bengals 22-20 on Monday Night Football.
What's New: Kagi launches Kagi Mail, an ad-free Gmail alternative for $9 a month after a 60-day trial. Turns out "free" email always had a bill. It just had better marketing.
What's New: Ladybird, a web browser running its own from-scratch engine (not a Chrome fork), is now in alpha for Mac and Linux. Crashes included, as advertised.
What's New: Euclid space telescope finds the oldest known quasar, formed just 630 million years after the Big Bang. It broke its own record from July.
Took a Hit: Blade Runner 2099 debuts at 72% on Rotten Tomatoes. Still fresh, but the lowest score in the franchise (2049 sits at 88%).
